event.description: Reduce interleaved model feed-forward width from 44 to 32
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 5,792 parameters at 99.930000%, a +0.930000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There has been 1 prior attempt in this family. There is no accepted result labeled in-family; the most recent failed result is attempt-0001, an optimization failure for ff_dim=44 under the original separated operand representation, which reached 98.85% internal validation without a checkpoint. Attempt-0005 subsequently changed token geometry and reached a 99.97% internal checkpoint by step 9,000. Hypothesis: adjacent interleaved digit columns reduce nonlinear routing demand enough to shrink both GELU hidden widths from 44 to 32, a parameterization-preserving compression removing 768 parameters. This is more informative than the nearest untested ff_dim=38 because the observed fourfold convergence acceleration supports a decisive width-slack probe; the retained step-15,000 abort bounds a stall.
